limitations.text: use the graph recurrent neural networks (GRNN) to model the sequential behaviors of users

limitations.text: need to simultaneously consider the characteristics of user-item interactions and user-user social relations
limitations.quote: It should be noted that GNN encoders for SocialRS need to simultaneously consider the characteristics of user-item interactions and user-user social relations. This is in contrast with GNN encoders for non-SocialRS that model only user-item interactions.

limitations.text: employ well-known loss functions, such as mean squared error (MSE), Bayesian personalized ranking (BPR), and cross-entropy (CE), to reconstruct user behaviors

limitations.text: have additionally employed auxiliary loss functions such as self-supervised loss and group-based loss

limitations.text: existing GNN-based SocialRS methods only focus on adding edges between two users or between a user and an item

properties.text: TCL is proposed as a category to classify works that introduce the CL philosophy into temporal data mining to handle distribution shifts and catastrophic forgetting.
properties.quote: We thus propose a category named Temporal Continual Learning (TCL) to classify these works.

limitations.text: The high cost of re-training or updating models necessitates the development of more lightweight training methods and efficient CL strategies.
limitations.quote: Therefore, more lightweight training methods and efficient CL strategies need to be devised.

limitations.text: Current CL methods focus on single or few domains, whereas LLMs require learning extensive knowledge across various domains.
limitations.quote: Consequently, continual learning methods for LLMs must be particularly designed such that LLMs can learn extensive knowledge across various domains.

limitations.text: There is an urgent need to design insightful theories to guide the CL methods for LLMs due to the absence of rigid analysis.
limitations.quote: There is an urgent need to design insightful theories to guide the CL methods for LLMs.

limitations.text: The main bottleneck is the lack of well-developed large unified models, and key technologies like large-scale pre-training have not been adapted to urban data structures.
limitations.quote: We believe that the trend would be to develop large unified models for processing different types of urban data.

limitations.text: lack of high-quality and large-scale urban multi-modal datasets
limitations.quote: The first one is the lack of high-quality and large-scale urban multi-modal datasets.

limitations.text: existing multi-modal models become insufficient, and performing only fine-tuning can hardly meet the actual needs
limitations.quote: However, when it comes to some data modes unique to urban computing, such as traffic and weather data, existing multi-modal models become insufficient, and performing only fine-tuning can hardly meet the actual needs.

limitations.text: there is a large room for developing multi-modal models with continual learning abilities in smart city environments
limitations.quote: Some existing studies are limited to specific tasks and modes [ 154 , 150 , 156 ] , so there is a large room for developing multi-modal models with continual learning abilities in smart city environments.

limitations.text: Existing research mainly focuses on solving OOD problems, leaving substantial room for achieving the goals of self-education and lifelong education, and has not paid particular attention to urban applications.
limitations.quote: However, these studies primarily concentrate on addressing the OOD problem, leaving much room of realizing the aforementioned objectives of self-education and lifelong education. Additionally, they didn’t particularly focus on urban applications, where there are more intricate scenarios and demands.

limitations.text: The security research community needs to define more comprehensive criteria for evaluating privacy and security attacks in real systems.
limitations.quote: From one aspect, the security research community needs to define more comprehensive criteria for evaluating privacy and security attacks in real systems.

limitations.text: Stronger protection techniques such as robust encryption algorithms should be developed, which are required for secure data collection and exchange.
limitations.quote: Also, stronger protection techniques such as robust encryption algorithms should be developed, which are required for secure data collection and exchange.

limitations.text: The continual learning community needs to research how intelligent models (central or distributed) can perform continual learning securely, especially when dealing with incomplete data pieces because of privacy or security constraints.
limitations.quote: From another aspect, the continual learning community needs to research how intelligent models (central or distributed) can perform continual learning securely, especially when dealing with incomplete data pieces because of privacy or security constraints.

limitations.text: There is a need to explore continual learning methods that can actively and selectively forget.
limitations.quote: Hence, there is a need to explore continual learning methods that can actively and selectively forget.

limitations.text: There is very little research on this regard
limitations.quote: There is very little research on this regard.

limitations.text: proposed an interpretable class-incremental learning framework that can reduce the interpretability concept drift
limitations.quote: For example, ICICLE [ 232 ] proposed an interpretable class-incremental learning framework that can reduce the interpretability concept drift.

limitations.text: Smart city related CL works are in a strong uptrend and many promising challenges remain open.
limitations.quote: This implies that smart city related CL works are in a strong uptrend and many promising challenges remain open.

limitations.text: None of the existing surveys has particularly focused on the continual learning work done for urban computing or smart cities.
limitations.quote: Despite the rich number of surveys, none has particularly focused on the continual learning work done for urban computing or smart cities, where many important studies should not be overlooked.

limitations.text: The CIL scenario is a more recent research hotspot in the vision community, but it has not been fully investigated in smart city research.
limitations.quote: The CIL scenario is a more recent research hotspot in the vision community, but it has not been fully investigated in smart city research.

limitations.text: Current research on dynamic graphs mainly focuses on changes on node features or edges, with less consideration on the addition of nodes and sub-graphs, which may cause catastrophic forgetting.
limitations.quote: However, current research on dynamic graphs mainly focuses on changes on node features or edges, with less consideration on the addition of nodes and sub-graphs, which may cause catastrophic forgetting.

limitations.text: The catastrophic forgetting problem in many multi-task and multi-modal learning works has not been well solved.
limitations.quote: Despite the success, the catastrophic forgetting problem in many multi-task and multi-modal learning works has not been well solved.

limitations.text: The primary limitation results from the high cost (computational, financial, time) of re-training or updating models, requiring more lightweight training methods and efficient CL strategies.
limitations.quote: First, the primary limitation results from the high cost (computational, financial, time) of re-training or updating models. Therefore, more lightweight training methods and efficient CL strategies need to be devised.

limitations.text: New data for fine-tuning large models are dramatically small compared to the model size, inhibiting large models from effectively acquiring new knowledge.
limitations.quote: Often, new data for fine-tuning large models are dramatically small compared to the model size, so this inhibits large models from effectively acquiring new knowledge.

limitations.text: Current CL methods primarily focus on maximizing knowledge within a single or few domains, whereas LLMs are designed for strong generalization across numerous domains.
limitations.quote: However, current CL methods primarily focus on maximizing knowledge within a single or few domains. Consequently, continual learning methods for LLMs must be particularly designed such that LLMs can learn extensive knowledge across various domains.

limitations.text: The absence of rigid analysis poses a significant challenge, with an urgent need to design insightful theories to guide the CL methods for LLMs.
limitations.quote: Furthermore, the absence of rigid analysis also poses a significant challenge to continual learning for LLMs. There is an urgent need to design insightful theories to guide the CL methods for LLMs.

limitations.text: Ethical issues matter as LLMs must adhere to social morality and legal requirements, which is a critical issue during the continual learning phase.
